description: This file contains tests for a port management system, including functions to occupy ports, find free ports, reserve ports, and release ports, ensuring correct behavior under various conditions.

methods.name: occupyPort
methods.description: Helper function to occupy a system port by creating a listener on a random available port and then closing it, returning the listener and port number.

methods.name: TestDefaultPortManager_FindFreePortSkipsBusyAndReserved
methods.description: Test to verify that the port manager correctly skips busy and reserved ports when finding a free port.

methods.name: TestDefaultPortManager_ReserveAndReleaseLifecycle
methods.description: Test to validate the reservation and release lifecycle of ports, including error handling for double reservations and releases of unreserved ports.

methods.name: TestDefaultPortManager_ReserveFailsWhenSystemPortBusy
methods.description: Test to ensure that reserving an already busy system port results in an error.
